architecture.type: decoder-only transformer (chat-tuned on phone-book AI profiles)

capability_boundary.default: DEFAULT = no network calls. Currently free for all internet tasks; tool libraries that use the network say so on their card.
capability_boundary.model: local text generation only — no network, no files, no device access
capability_boundary.tools: optional plug-in tool libraries; only the ones you load run, and only as page JavaScript

modes.fallback_rule: If the trained model fails to load at runtime, the site says so by name (ENGINE_LOAD_FAILED, MODEL_NOT_FOUND, MODEL_CORRUPT, BROWSER_UNSUPPORTED, OUT_OF_MEMORY, NETWORK_REQUIRED) and falls back to Guide Mode. The mode is always labeled on every answer.
modes.guide: live — on-site knowledge-base guide (28 entries), used when you ask the guide, or when the trained model cannot load
modes.trained_model: live — answers generated by SIGLLAMA-V2 weights in your browser

offline: First load needs an internet connection (engine + ~4 MB weights). Afterwards your browser's HTTP cache can serve the files offline. Offline use is not guaranteed and has not been lab-tested; it depends on your browser's cache.

weights.format: SGLL v1 binary, int8 per-row scales
